These offerings drive measurable business results for customers. The business is focused on outcome-based software solutions and engineering services, converting data into actions for the customer which enables greater reliability, safety and uptime & profitability. These solutions uniquely combine domain expertise and industry proven technology. Global Engineering Services (GES) Global Engineering Services is the key largescale engineering, productivity, new growth initiative and process standardization enabler for HPS and outside HPS. With the largest skilled engineering pool available to PAS, LSS, HCP and Cyber and ready to expand to other GBEs, GES helps win GMPs and executes them, does design, engineer and execute all the other PAS, LSS, HCI and Cyber projects based out of major engineering centers at India, China, Bucharest and Uzbekistan, helps all the LOBs to carry out engineering and process standardization to improve the engineering quality and productivity and also supports all the LOBs in supporting migrations and long-term service contracts. THE OPPORTUNITY The Project Engineer I/Project Engineer II (APC/Optimization) will support the lead to implement Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer projects and assist in onsite user training as necessary. The candidate should have a very strong career interest in Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer work. YOU MUST HAVE Has a at least 10+ years of experience in refining/petrochemical, MMM industry. Has a background in Chemical Engineering principles and operations. Knowledge of regulatory control and advanced control. Understands optimization principles. Experience in implementing global optimization programs is advantages. Good communication and writing skills. Knowledge of Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer, DCS and real-time database technologies. Good team player. Strong ability to maintain good working relationship with customers. WE VALUE Demonstrated project experience implementing commercial off-the-shelf software for APC such as DMC3/DMC Plus, SMOC, PACE, ROMeo. Experience in deploying APC or maintenance management strategies in an operating company. Candidates having experience in plant operations. Experience in plant startup & commissioning Configuration experience working on control systems, DCS / PLC / Safety Systems. Advanced post graduate degree in a technical discipline. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The role will have a broad set of responsibilities encompassing the following: Execute Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer projects including assessment, kick-off, pre-test, plant test, design, modeling, configuration, installation, commissioning, and post-audit. Implement RMPCT Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer/Control Performance Monitor technologies as Lead Consultant/Engineer Perform/Participate in Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer studies, proof of concepts/trial evaluation and provide user training. Review the economic targets for the Advanced Process Controllers, suggest and incorporate necessary changes, to provide the right direction to the controllers. This may be required to incorporate the new economic indicators, if any, and make the controller to constantly work towards the current economic objectives. Identify, advise, and incorporate modifications to the controller configuration, in terms of proposing addition of new variables/ constraints, deletion of the redundant variables, wherever found necessary. Identify faulty regulatory control loops in the system (DCS level) and carryout tuning of existing regulatory controller at Distributed control systems. Lead cross function teams such as the Customer Support and R&D to resolve Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer issues. Support Sales and Marketing to grow Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer licenses and services business. Support and train junior personnel

title: Customer Success Professional
description:
About the Role: We re expanding our Customer Success team at Z Tok with 10+ open positions. We are building India s first network CRM for conversational commerce, and your job is to ensure our clients actually adopt and see massive value from our Agentic AI on WhatsApp Business. As part of the Customer Success team at ZoTok, you will play a critical role in ensuring our clients adopt, implement and derive maximum value from our platform. This is not a passive support role - you are expected to own accounts end to end, drive technical delivery, manage stakeholders, and grow revenue through upsells and expansions. We are hiring across multiple sub-roles within Customer Success - from onboarding and activation to key account management and technical project delivery. Each role requires a combination of technical aptitude, commercial instinct and strong client relationship skills. 
 The Basics: Experience: 2 to 10 years Early joiners preferred. Roles & Responsibilities Onboarding & Implementation Own end-to-end client onboarding - from contract closure to first bill generation and successful product adoption. Understand client business requirements and configure, customize and integrate ZoTok within their existing systems. Manage technical project delivery including timelines, milestones and go-live planning. Work with integration tools including Postman, APIs and ERP connectors to ensure seamless setup. Account Management & Revenue Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts - building strong, long-lasting relationships with decision-makers. Monitor account health scores, product usage and adoption metrics using Odoo and internal CRM tools. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities post-onboarding and drive revenue expansion. Own and manage revenue responsibility for assigned accounts - retention and growth are your KPIs. Sell Done-for-You models where you directly drive business outcomes for clients using ZoTok. Technical & Product Conduct product demonstrations tailored to client-specific needs and industry workflows. Perform QA and UAT validation during implementation to ensure product is configured correctly. Gather and document client requirements using BA methodologies - BRDs, user stories and process maps. Collaborate with internal Tech, Product and Integration teams to resolve client issues promptly. Stakeholder Management Manage internal pushback from client-side blockers and influencers who fear automation - convince them ZoTok makes their work easier. Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) with key stakeholders and present performance reports. Provide training to client teams to ensure they are fully equipped to use ZoTok independently. Serve as a trusted advisor - not just a support contact - throughout the client journey. What are we looking for Experience & Background 2-10 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Onboarding, Technical Project Delivery or similar roles in IT/SaaS industry. Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Odoo or similar is a strong advantage. Background in technical implementation, SaaS onboarding or BA roles is highly preferred. Working experience in Distribution, Supply Chain or B2B Commerce industries is a plus. Bachelors degree mandatory - negotiable for candidates with strong relevant experience. Technical Skills Familiarity with Postman, REST APIs and integration workflows. Experience with QA processes, UAT and product testing. Proficiency in CRM tools - Salesforce, Odoo, HubSpot or similar. Basic understanding of ERP workflows - SAP, Tally, Zoho or similar. Ability to read and interpret API documentation and integration specs. Soft Skills & Mindset Commercial Instinct - you dont just support clients, you spot expansion opportunities and drive upsells naturally. Stakeholder Management - you can hold a room, manage pushback and get buy-in from skeptical decision-makers. Ownership Mindset - you drive tasks to completion without being told and think proactively about what comes next. Communication - excellent verbal and written communication with clients, leadership and internal teams. Adaptability - ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. 
 What matters more than the resume: Stakeholder Management & Persuasion: You can hold a room and manage pushback from insecure internal influencers who fear automation. Technical - Postman, REST APIs, QA/UAT, CRM tools (Salesforce, Odoo), ERP background (SAP, Tally, Zoho) - advantage. Domain - Supply chain, distribution, B2B commerce or SaaS implementation background - strongly preferred. Mindset - Commercial instinct, ownership, stakeholder management and hunger to make clients genuinely successful. Commercial Instinct: You dont just support clients; you spot expansion opportunities and naturally drive upsells post-onboarding. Industry & SaaS Context: Deep familiarity with supply chain, distribution, or B2B SaaS workflows to guide clients. 
 Why Join ZoTok At ZoTok, you wont be managing accounts - you will be shaping how Indias businesses operate on WhatsApp. Youll work at the intersection of AI, commerce and technology, building something that has never been done before in India. 
 Be part of Indias first Network CRM for conversational commerce - a category-defining product. Work directly with Brands, Distributors and Retailers across Indias $1 trillion+ General Trade ecosystem. Deep domain expertise in Supply Chain Management and B2B SaaS - skills that compound over time. Fast-paced, ownership-driven culture where your impact is visible and rewarded. Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale rapidly across India and globally. ZoTok occupies a niche market with tremendous demand. Join us and be part of something truly extraordinary - redefining Conversational Commerce in India and beyond. Required Skills Stakeholder Management Revenue Responsibility Supply Chain Product Understanding Product adoption Technical Sound Customer Onboarding

CloudFront, ECS) Experience with WebSocket-based real-time features in React Understanding of Content Security Policy and browser security headers Familiarity with React Native for future mobile work Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition. 
 Role Overview: We are looking for an SDE II - Sensors to build customer-deployed security software that runs inside enterprise environments and continuously discovers assets, evaluates exposures, and securely communicates telemetry back to SAFE. 
 This role is suited for engineers with strong C++, Go or Python programming skills, Windows/Linux, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals , particularly those who have worked on endpoint agents, security sensors, network/security products, or other long-running system software . What Youll Do: Design and develop lightweight security sensors/agents running inside customer environments. Build capabilities for asset discovery, network scanning, vulnerability detection and exposure validation . Develop reliable, long-running system software with a focus on performance, resource usage, concurrency, and stability . Work extensively with Windows/Linux internals, processes, sockets, filesystems, networking and system APIs . Build communication between distributed sensors and the SAFE cloud with secure authentication, encryption, retries and offline recovery . Implement sensor lifecycle management, including installation, configuration, health monitoring and software/rule updates. Debug complex issues spanning application code, operating systems, customer networks, proxies, firewalls and infrastructure . Build strong diagnostics, telemetry and logging so problems can be investigated without requiring direct access to customer systems. Participate in low-level and high-level design discussions and independently own well-defined components/features through production. What Were Looking For: 3-6 years of software development experience , preferably building systems, infrastructure or security products. Strong programming experience in one or more of C++, Go or Python . Strong understanding of Windows/Linux and operating-system fundamentals . Good understanding of networking concepts, including: TCP/IP and sockets DNS HTTP/HTTPS TLS Proxies Routing NAT Firewalls and network segmentation Experience with multithreading/concurrency, asynchronous programming and inter-process communication . Understanding of software security and secure communication practices. Ability to troubleshoot issues independently across code, OS and network boundaries . Strongly Preferred: Experience building endpoint agents, sensors, collectors, daemons or system services . Experience working on cybersecurity, endpoint security, vulnerability management, micro-segmentation, EDR or network security products . Experience building software deployed across large heterogeneous enterprise environments . Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, vulnerability scanners and exposure management . Experience with secure auto-update / software distribution mechanisms . Familiarity with containers and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes . Experience developing software that needs to operate reliably across Windows and Linux environments . What Good Looks Like: You should be comfortable going beyond: "The API returned an error." and investigating: Sensor process socket DNS proxy/firewall network cloud service to determine exactly where and why something failed. You should be equally comfortable reasoning about: Why is a process consuming excessive CPU or memory Why communication works in one customer network but fails in another How to safely upgrade thousands of deployed sensors How to recover when a sensor loses connectivity for several hours How to execute security scans without destabilising customer infrastructure How to collect enough diagnostics to troubleshoot systems you cannot directly access The ideal candidate is fundamentally a systems/security engineer who can build reliable software , rather than a conventional CRUD/backend application developer. If you re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that s redefining security, we want to hear from you!

description:
Job Summary Your role sits exactly there. You will own a defined slice of the Applied AI roadmap - architecting the agentic and retrieval systems behind it, owning their lifecycle in production, and growing a small team of engineers who build alongside you. It is deliberately a hands-on leadership role: you keep writing and reviewing code while owning delivery, quality, and the growth of the people on your team. A Day in the Life You own AI systems end to end - from problem framing with product and customer teams through architecture, evaluation, deployment, and the cost and latency profile they run at. System ownership: Architecture. Design production agentic and RAG systems that meet real customer scale and reliability requirements, not benchmark conditions. Orchestration depth: Apply agent design patterns with judgment - memory, tool routing, multi-agent coordination, and explicit failure handling - and decide deliberately where autonomy stops and a human takes over. Retrieval quality: Own the retrieval pipeline as a first-class system: chunking strategy, embedding model selection, vector stores, re-ranking, and relevance tuning against measured outcomes. LLMOps lifecycle: Own model and prompt versioning, eval pipelines running in CI, observability (tracing, token and cost dashboards), and the guardrails and safety filters that ship with every release. Model strategy: Select, fine-tune, and serve SLMs and open models - LoRA and QLoRA, quantization, inference optimization, GPU and serving trade-offs. Engineering economics: Optimize latency, cost, and accuracy together, and make defensible build-versus-buy and model-selection calls you can explain to both engineers and executives. Beyond the codebase Define and execute the quarterly roadmap for your area, and translate ambiguous business problems into machine learning problems with clear solution workflows. Work with business leaders and customers directly to understand where the workflow actually breaks, then build for that. Partner with the data platform and applications teams so your capabilities land inside their products and workflows rather than beside them. Set the coding and evaluation standards for your team, and lead design reviews. Pursue published work or patents where the problem warrants it - particularly in healthcare AI. What You Need 6+ years in data science, applied ML, or AI engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-powered products. Healthcare experience is a plus. Deep NLP and GenAI experience. Statistical and classical machine learning is good to have on top of that. Strong hands-on Python - building highly scalable, performant enterprise applications, plus optimization technique. Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks: PyTorch and/or HuggingFace transformers. At least one shipped GenAI product with a genuinely complex architecture - multiple agents, memory, retrieval, and agent OTEL/tracing in production. Working command of modern fine-tuning: PEFT methods, with LoRA and QLoRA preferred. Hands-on experience with at least one ML platform - Databricks, Azure ML, or SageMaker. Experience leading engineers, formally or as a technical lead - you have owned other people's output, not only your own. Strong written and spoken communication, with a customer-focused instinct in both conversation and documentation. Preferably a Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. The engineering baseline we assume Everything above sits on top of independent delivery. This role assumes you can already do the following without supervision: Build production-grade RAG and LLM/SLM-powered features end to end with limited supervision. Work fluently in at least one orchestration framework - LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or equivalent - to compose multi-step, tool-using flows. Design retrieval pipelines and tune them for relevance: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, re-ranking. Implement prompt engineering, function and tool calling, and reliable structured-output parsing. Write and run evals - golden sets, LLM-as-judge - to measure quality and catch regressions before customers do. Containerize and deploy services (Docker, REST/gRPC) with an eye on latency, token cost, and basic guardrails. Document well and participate actively in code review. Good to have API frameworks for robust web applications - FastAPI or Django preferred. Comfort with at least one hyperscaler cloud. Papers or patents, especially in healthcare AI.

Tracking & Heuristics: Implement and refine temporal tracking logic and spatial prior mathematics to stabilize OCR predictions and handle object occlusion. Multimodal Fusion Readiness: Collaborate on architecting feature embeddings that fuse 2D visual data with physical sensor telemetry (LiDAR profiling, Radar speed). Edge Optimization: Collaborate with deployment engineers to ensure models adhere to strict latency and compute constraints for real-time edge hardware execution.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 Broad function: The Senior Data Engineer - VARTA SENSE will be responsible for designing, developing, and managing scalable and reliable data pipelines that form the core data foundation of the VARTA SENSE platform. The role will work closely with the ML Lead, Solution Architect, Backend Engineering team and other technology stakeholders to transform complex banking and transaction data into standardized, reusable and production-ready datasets and features. The position requires strong hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, data pipelines, orchestration, data quality and distributed data processing, with particular emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability and secure deployment within restricted banking environments. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Data Pipeline Development & Engineering: Design and develop scalable batch, incremental and production-grade data pipelines for large volumes of transaction and customer data. Build standardized and reusable data models and canonical schemas for transactions, customer attributes, offers, exposure and outcome events. Develop configurable ingestion and mapping frameworks to integrate data received from different banks and source systems. Manage pipeline orchestration including dependencies, checkpointing, retries, partial failures, backfills and safe replay mechanisms. Implement deduplication, late-arriving data handling, incremental loads, CDC, watermarking and merge/upsert processing. Data Quality, Reconciliation & Governance: Establish strong data-quality controls, automated testing, source-to-target reconciliation and schema validation. Ensure data lineage and schema evolution are properly managed across pipelines. Proactively identify and prevent issues such as missing data, duplicate records, incorrect aggregations, silent data loss and double counting. Maintain reliable and auditable data-processing standards across production environments. ML Feature Engineering Support: Work closely with the ML Lead to develop and maintain analytical and ML feature pipelines. Ensure consistency between training and production/inference datasets. Maintain point-in-time correctness and prevent data leakage within feature pipelines. Support versioned analytical features and reusable feature definitions. Performance & Scalability: Optimize large-scale data-processing workloads through effective partitioning, query optimization, join strategies, memory management and I/O optimization. Benchmark workloads against expected transaction volumes and available infrastructure. Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve processing speed, stability and infrastructure utilization. Ensure data pipelines remain scalable as transaction volumes and customer deployments increase. Deployment, Security & Production Reliability: Develop and support pipelines for deployment within bank-controlled on-premise and private-cloud environments. Ensure pipelines can operate in restricted or offline environments without public-internet dependency at runtime. Implement appropriate controls for PII handling, encryption, tokenization, masking, access management and secure connectivity. Establish monitoring and alerting for pipeline failures, data-quality issues, infrastructure bottlenecks and processing delays. Define and maintain backfill, replay, recovery and disaster-recovery procedures for critical pipelines. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with ML, Architecture, Backend Engineering, DevOps and Infrastructure teams to design and deliver reliable data solutions. Collaborate with development partners to reproduce, transition and operationalize data pipelines within FCI. Support integration between data platforms and downstream application / ML services. Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews and production troubleshooting. Reusability, Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Build reusable adapters and configuration layers so that onboarding a new bank can be managed through configuration and mapping rather than changes to the core product code. Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks and operational procedures. Document architecture decisions, troubleshooting steps and recovery procedures. Enable alternate engineering resources to independently operate and troubleshoot critical pipelines. Participate in code reviews, Git-based development, CI/CD practices and continuous improvement of engineering standards. 
 
 Requirements 
 5-9 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, with hands-on ownership of production-grade data pipelines. Strong hands-on expertise in Python and Advanced SQL. Strong understanding of SQL concepts including window functions, query optimization and query-plan analysis. Practical experience with distributed data-processing platforms such as Apache Spark / PySpark or equivalent technologies. Experience building and managing production pipelines using Apache Airflow or an equivalent orchestration framework. Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch processing and incremental data pipelines. Experience working with Parquet and other columnar data formats, partitioning, schema evolution and reconciliation. Practical experience with CDC / incremental ingestion technologies and concepts. Exposure to technologies such as Kafka, Debezium or equivalent event / CDC platforms would be preferred. Experience implementing automated Data Quality frameworks using tools such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda or equivalent. Understanding of Data Lineage and Metadata Management using OpenLineage, Marquez or similar self-hosted solutions would be an advantage. Experience with lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi would be preferred. Exposure to Feature Store platforms such as Feast or equivalent would be beneficial. Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, Docker and Linux environments. Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent platforms. Strong understanding of production support, troubleshooting, performance tuning and failure recovery. Ability to clearly explain technical design decisions, performance trade-offs and production engineering challenges. Strong collaboration skills with Data Science, ML, Backend Engineering, Architecture and Infrastructure teams.

Responsibilities Define and evolve the long-term database and data infrastructure strategy across the company. Design architectures capable of supporting the next order of magnitude of growth in data volume and traffic. Establish architectural standards and paved roads for database selection, data modeling, partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, availability, and data lifecycle. Lead complex, cross-team initiatives such as database migrations, re-platforming, sharding, multiregion architectures, and major scalability improvements. Identify systemic reliability, scalability, and capacity risks before they become critical production problems. Drive database platform capabilities that make infrastructure more self-service, observable, reliable, and easier to operate for engineering teams. Develop strategies for capacity planning, data growth, archival, disaster recovery, and infrastructure efficiency. Identify opportunities to materially improve database infrastructure cost and performance at company scale. Evaluate new database technologies and architectures and make pragmatic build-vs-buy and technology-selection decisions. Partner with senior engineers and engineering leadership on architecture and long-term technical direction. Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar for database and distributed-systems engineering across the organization. Requirements Significant experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior individual contributor, solving infrastructure or database problems across multiple teams. Deep understanding of database internals and distributed systems, including storage, indexing, partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, transactions, availability, and failure modes. Experience designing and operating production database systems with multi-terabyte or larger datasets. Experience with high-throughput systems handling 30K-50K+ operations per second, preferably at substantially higher scale. Strong production experience across multiple database technologies and database architectures, including both relational and NoSQL/distributed systems. Experience leading major architectural changes, migrations, or scaling initiatives involving multiple engineering teams. Strong understanding of database reliability, capacity planning, observability, and infrastructure economics. Ability to take ambiguous technical problems, establish a direction, build alignment, and drive them through execution. PAN INDIA Role: Senior Database Engineer About the Job We are looking for a hands-on Senior Database Engineer with strong experience in large-scale SQL-based data transformation and database performance optimisation. The role will focus primarily on developing and maintaining native database transformations that convert data from multiple legacy source models into canonical data models used by cloud-based applications and microservices. The successful candidate will work with large data volumes and will be expected to design scalable SQL transformations, stored procedures, functions, and views, while ensuring that database performance remains efficient as data volumes grow. This role involves working closely with architects, product owners, data engineers, and other engineering teams, so strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills are important. About You You will have a strong background in hands-on database engineering and complex data transformation, ideally within AWS environments using PostgreSQL and/or MySQL. You should be comfortable taking a legacy data model and designing the SQL transformation required to map it into a new canonical model across multiple tables. title: FEA Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a candidate who will be responsible for finite element analysis (FEA) activities using MSC Nastran and OptiStruct and support knowledge development projects. Your mission will be to support new product development for FEA activities and assist in FEA knowledge development at Global Engineering Center India Airpower. You should have a very high penchant for engineering analysis and analytical work. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 You perform advanced FEA analyses for a wide range of applications and products. In close collaboration with your internal client and with the necessary creativity you translate your findings to a performant and cost-effective design. The client is guided by you from the moment you receive the request up to the implementation of the solution. In all projects a customer focused approach is crucial. You are able to analyze the client's problem and assess if he needs a simple hand calculation or a more complex FEA simulation. It is your task to select the most efficient and accurate solution strategy to tackle the job. Components analyzed include compressor/pump frames, rotors, housings etc. Type of analyses includes linear static, non-linear and dynamic calculations. You remain up to date with the latest developments in the CAE/FEA domain. You identify opportunities to improve and/or expand our calculation models and tools. And together with your colleagues you introduce these improvements in our processes worldwide and develop the static structural and dynamic competence domain in Atlas Copco. Interaction with overseas Atlas Copco customers on a regular basis is required. Provide CAE support to customers in phase of product development and product enhancement. Support competence development and following best practices in CAE. Compliance to ISO Procedures. 
 
 Experience requirements 
 2-4 years of FEA experience, experience on compressors/pumps is an added advantage. 
 
 Knowledge 
 An in-depth knowledge of FEA, Applied Mechanics, Dynamics of structure. Hands-on experience in HyperMesh / HyperView / SimLab / Inspire / SimSolid as pre/post-processor and Nastran/OptiStruct as solver is a must, and the candidate needs to be a dependable resource to the team in these areas. Should be able to perform linear, nonlinear and dynamic analysis on 3D solid components. Experience on pressure vessels or power train is essential. Ability to convert problem statements into FEA model strategy definition and results into solutions is essential. The ideal candidate shall be able to judge and interpret the analysis results with a critical attitude. Should possess FE modeling reviewing skills and quality awareness. Experience in the areas below is an added advantage Performing modal / frequency-response / random-vibration / vibration-fatigue calculations/ Experience on Rotordynamics simulations Correlation of simulation results to test particularly in the dynamics domain Experience in providing solutions to vibration problem Knowledge of standards/codes (ASCE/EN/DNV) is an added advantage Knowledge of ASME Sec. VIII Div.1/2 for strength and fatigue analysis of vessels is desired Experience in below programming skills is an added advantage Unix-Shell scripts TCL/TK Python Matlab HTML AI/Machine Learning 
 
 Educational requirements 
 M.Tech/M.E. 
 
 Personality requirements 
 Research attitude Good interpersonal skills and positive attitude. Dynamic and energetic. Good presentation, business communication and analytical skills. High achievement drive and willingness to accept challenges Customer focused.

title: Senior AI Full-Stack Engineer
description:
What we are looking for Senior AI Full-Stack Engineer Company: Grey Chain AI Location: Remote Experience: 8+ Years Employment Type: Full Time 
 About the Role We are growing our engineering teams and hiring senior full-stack engineers who have already shipped LLM-powered features to real users and want to do it at the level of a platform rather than a single app. You will work flexibly across two kinds of work, and most engineers here do both. Platform work: building the capabilities of our agent platform itself new agent types, tools and MCP servers, skills, the codeexecution sandbox, workflow and long-running task infrastructure, ingestion pipelines, and the graph, vector and ontology layers that agents reason over. Product work: building client-facing AI products on that platform, from data model to API to UI, integrated into the client's Microsoft 365, Salesforce or identity estate, and deployed into their own cloud environment. Both kinds of work share a shape: a Python backend, a React/Next.js front-end, PostgreSQL underneath, an LLM in the loop, and an enterprise client at the end of it who expects the result to be secure, multi-tenant, auditable and fast. You will own features end to end schema, service, agent behaviour, UI, tests, and the evals that prove the LLM part actually works. You will join engineering teams that already ship to production. We expect you to raise the bar on them: through the quality of your own work, your code reviews, and your willingness to say when something is not good enough. 
 What you will build and own Agentic features, end to end. Design and build agent workflows that solve real enterprise tasks: retrieval over client documents and structured data, multi-step tool use, specialised agents that hand off to one another, long-running jobs with durable state, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Own the prompts, the tool definitions, the orchestration logic and the evals not just the API around them. Tools, MCP servers and skills . Build the tools agents call MCP servers over client systems and internal services, skills that package repeatable capabilities, and sandboxed code execution for data analysis. Design them so they are safe to expose to an LLM: strict schemas, least-privilege credentials, idempotency, and clear failure modes. Data layer. Design PostgreSQL schemas that hold up under multi-tenant load and years of client data. Build ingestion pipelines for documents, structured data and enterprise sources; own chunking, embedding, indexing and the vector, graph and ontology structures that make retrieval accurate. Write the SQL that analytics agents generate and know when they are generating it badly. Enterprise integration. Integrate with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Salesforce and client identity providers using OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, including delegated and On-Behalf-Of flows so agents act with the user's permissions, not a service account's. Respect the client's existing RBAC and data boundaries in everything you build. Multi-tenant product engineering. Build features that are tenant-isolated by construction: row-level security or schema-per-tenant where appropriate, tenant-scoped credentials and vector indexes, per-tenant cost attribution, audit logging that a client's security team will accept. Front-end . Build the interfaces through which users work with agents chat and task UIs, streaming responses, citations and provenance, review-and-approve flows, dashboards and admin consoles in React/Next.js and TypeScript, to a standard you would put in front of a client executive. Quality and evaluation. Write the tests. Build eval sets for every LLM-driven feature and run them on every change. Instrument agents with tracing so that when a client asks "why did it say that", you can answer. 
 What we are looking for 
 Must have 
 5-8 years building production web applications, with the last 2+ spent as a full-stack engineer owning features from database to UI. You have shipped LLM features to real users RAG, tool-calling, structured extraction or agent workflows using Claude, OpenAI, Bedrock or Azure OpenAI APIs, and you can talk concretely about what went wrong: hallucinations, latency, token cost, prompt regressions, retrieval misses, and how you measured and fixed them. • Strong Python backend engineering: FastAPI or similar async frameworks, typed code (Pydantic, mypy), background workers, and API design you would be happy to hand to another team. Strong React/Next.js and TypeScript you build the UI well, not merely tolerate it. Streaming, optimistic updates, complex forms and accessible components should all be familiar. Deep PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing and query performance, migrations, transactions, and experience with pgvector or a comparable vector store. Enterprise integration in production: at least one of Microsoft Graph / SharePoint, Salesforce, or OAuth 2.0 / OIDC SSO against Entra ID or Okta including the delegated-permission flows, not just app-only tokens. Multi-tenant SaaS experience: tenant isolation, RBAC, audit logging, and the discipline to keep data from one client from ever reaching another. You test your work and expect others to. Unit, integration and LLM evals are part of the definition of done, not a follow-up ticket. Clear written and spoken English; comfortable demoing to and taking questions from client stakeholders. 
 Strongly preferred 
 Hands-on with agent frameworks and protocols: MCP servers, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or comparable; durable workflow engines such as Temporal. Experience with sandboxed code execution for LLM-driven data analysis, or with graph databases and ontology-driven data models. Document processing at scale: OCR, layout-aware parsing, table extraction, chunking strategies. Observability for LLM applications: tracing platforms such as LangFuse or LangSmith, eval frameworks, cost dashboards. Working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) enough to own your service's deployment, not to run the cluster. Experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) as a serious part of your workflow. 
 How we work 
 Remote, India-based. Occasional travel to Delhi NCR for team days. Working hours. Standard India working hours. Our clients are in the UK, Europe and the Middle East, so you will occasionally take a late-afternoon or evening call to cover overlap this is the exception, not the routine. Ownership. You own what you ship. When a feature you built misbehaves in production, you lead the fix and the explanation. Joining. We are hiring for an immediate need and strongly prefer candidates who can join right away or are already serving notice. 
 Why this role You will build agentic systems that enterprises actually run their work on not demos across the full stack, from ingestion and retrieval through agent orchestration to the interface a client's team uses every day. You will work alongside engineering leadership that builds hands-on and knows exactly what good looks like, on a platform whose scope is growing faster than we can hire for it.

title: Manager Instructional Design
description:
Manager - Learning & Development (Content & Digital Learning) Location: India
 Department: Learning & Development / Talent Development
 Reports To: Head - Learning & Development Role Overview We are seeking an experienced and innovative Manager - Learning & Development to lead the design, development, and implementation of high-impact learning solutions across business operations. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in training content creation within the BPO industry , instructional design, digital learning technologies, and learner experience design. This role requires a strategic learning professional who can manage end-to-end learning projects, lead a team of content developers and instructional designers, and deliver engaging learning experiences through e-learning modules, AI-enabled learning solutions, digital simulations, gamification, and immersive learning technologies . The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of adult learning principles, business process training, and modern learning technologies, including Articulate 360, Adobe Captivate, AI-driven authoring tools, and simulation-based learning platforms . Key Responsibilities Learning Strategy & Content Development Design and implement scalable learning solutions aligned with business objectives and operational requirements. Lead the development of training curricula, facilitator guides, learner manuals, assessments, job aids, SOP-based learning content, and knowledge management resources. Create engaging and performance-focused learning experiences for customer service, sales, technical support, and back-office operations within a BPO environment. Apply instructional design methodologies such as ADDIE, SAM, Design Thinking, and Learning Experience Design (LxD). Ensure all learning content meets quality, compliance, and organizational standards. E-Learning & Digital Learning Solutions Develop interactive e-learning programs using Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, and Adobe Captivate . Design and implement simulation-based learning experiences to enhance learner engagement and skill application. Leverage AI-powered authoring tools and automation technologies to improve content development efficiency. Create scenario-based learning, branching simulations, gamified learning journeys, and interactive assessments. Drive adoption of innovative digital learning approaches, including virtual learning environments and immersive technologies. AI & Digital Simulation Innovation Lead initiatives involving Artificial Intelligence, digital simulations, virtual role-plays, and experiential learning solutions . Integrate AI-enabled learning tools for content creation, personalization, performance support, and learner analytics. Develop customer interaction simulations and process-based learning experiences that reflect real-world business scenarios. Evaluate emerging learning technologies and recommend solutions that improve learning effectiveness and business impact. Team Leadership & Capability Building Lead, coach, and mentor instructional designers, content developers, and learning specialists. Establish governance frameworks, content standards, and quality assurance processes. Drive continuous capability-building initiatives focused on modern instructional design practices and digital learning innovation. Promote a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Stakeholder & Project Management Manage multiple learning projects simultaneously while ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Partner with Operations, Quality, Training, SMEs, and Business Leaders to identify learning needs and performance gaps. Communicate project progress effectively and manage stakeholder expectations across multiple business functions. Ensure optimal resource allocation and project prioritization. Learning Analytics & Effectiveness Define and track learning metrics, including learner engagement, completion rates, knowledge retention, and performance improvement. Evaluate training effectiveness using Kirkpatrick's Evaluation Model and other measurement frameworks. Utilize learning analytics to drive continuous improvement and demonstrate business impact. Establish KPIs related to learner performance, operational efficiency, and training quality. Qualifications & Experience Experience 8-12 years of experience in Learning & Development, Instructional Design, or Learning Experience Design. Minimum 3-5 years of people management experience. Strong experience in BPO, Customer Experience, Shared Services, Contact Center, or Global Operations environments . Proven experience in content development, curriculum design, and digital learning implementation. Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree in Education, Human Resources, Business, Communications, or a related field. Certification in Instructional Design, Digital Learning, Learning Technologies, or Project Management is preferred. Core Skills & Competencies Content Creation & Instructional Design Expertise in instructional design and adult learning principles. Strong content writing, editing, and curriculum development capabilities. Experience developing SOP-based, process training, behavioral, and functional learning content. Ability to translate complex business processes into learner-friendly formats. Learning Technologies Advanced proficiency in: Articulate Storyline 360 Rise 360 Adobe Captivate Learning Management Systems (LMS) AI-enabled learning platforms Simulation and gamification tools AI & Digital Learning Hands-on experience with AI-powered content creation and learning technologies. Knowledge of digital simulations, virtual role-plays, and immersive learning experiences. Exposure to conversational AI, adaptive learning, and learner analytics platforms. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Strong people leadership and coaching skills. Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment. Excellent collaboration and relationship management capabilities. Strong project planning, execution, and governance skills. Communication Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong business writing and technical documentation expertise. Ability to present learning strategies and outcomes to leadership audiences. Success Measures Success in this role will be demonstrated through: Delivery of high-quality learning content and scalable digital learning solutions. Increased adoption of AI-driven learning methodologies and simulation-based training. Improved learner engagement, proficiency, and operational performance. Effective utilization of Articulate, Captivate, and digital learning technologies to drive business outcomes. Strong team performance, innovation, and capability development. Measurable impact on productivity, quality, customer experience, and operational KPIs. Preferred Attributes Experience working in global or matrix organizations. Exposure to digital transformation and workforce upskilling initiatives. Passion for learning innovation, AI technologies, and learner experience design. Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking abilities. Continuous learner with a growth mindset and a focus on business impact.

title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
description:
Job Summary AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members. The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Position expectations Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra Own well-scoped projects end to end on weekly-to-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly Solve day-to-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non-standard problems Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search and bring interesting developments back to the team Qualifications 3+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it Nice to Have Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries Familiarity with Jira and related tools Success measures In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes In six months, you will own a well-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best

title: Data Analyst
description:
Role: Data Analyst (Analytics & Insights) 
We are looking for a sharp, curiosity-driven Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. You won't just be "pulling data"; you will be the bridge between raw numbers and strategic decisions. 
In this role, you will own the full data lifecycle - from building automated pipelines and sleek visualizations to presenting high-stakes insights to our Product and leadership council. If you enjoy debunking myths with data and finding "the why" behind the "what," you'll fit right in. 
 Core Responsibilities: Metric & Dashboard Ownership: Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards that serve as the "source of truth" for the business. Insight Generation: Go beyond the surface level. Analyze trends and anomalies to provide actionable recommendations that drive growth. Stakeholder Communication: Lead the weekly Analytics Council reviews, translating complex technical findings into clear, executive-level narratives. Experimentation (A/B Testing): Design experiment frameworks, calculate sample sizes, and perform post-hoc analysis to determine the success of product or marketing changes. Ad-hoc Analysis: Support rapid-fire business questions with deep-dive investigations to support urgent decision-making. Automation & Efficiency: Identify repetitive manual reporting tasks and build scripts or workflows to automate them, freeing up time for high-value analysis. Innovation & Process Improvement: Constantly evaluate our data stack and methodologies. Propose new tools, statistical models, or data collection techniques to keep us ahead of the curve. 
 Technical Requirements 
 - Data Querying: Advanced SQL (Window functions, CTEs, Query optimization) - Visualization: Proficiency in Tableau, Power BI, or Looker - Programming: Python or R (specifically for data manipulation and automation) - Experimentation: Understanding of hypothesis testing, p-values, and confidence intervals - Data Cleaning: Experience with ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) 

 What Makes You a Great Fit 
- The "So What?" Factor: You don't just report that a metric moved; you explain why it moved and what the business should do about it.
- Precision: You have a high bar for data integrity. You'd rather double-check a join than present a wrong number.
- Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift based on new data.
- Storytelling: You can take a messy spreadsheet and turn it into a compelling 3-slide deck for executives.

 Qualifications 
- Experience: 2.5 years in an analytical role (Product, Marketing, or Business Analytics).
- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, etc.).
- Communication: Proven experience presenting to senior leadership or cross-functional stakeholders.

 We are not hiring manual testers. We are looking for an Automation Quality Engineer who builds quality in someone who writes the app-facing automation and contributes to the code that makes our mobile products testable and reliable. If you think of QE as engineering writing code, owning frameworks, and shipping confidence with every release this role is for you. Seniority is not the advantage here; maturity, smartness, and the ability to communicate clearly are what set candidates apart. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Test Automation & Engineering 
 - Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for our mobile apps (Android and iOS) UI, functional, integration, and regression that run reliably in CI.
 - Write real code alongside the team: build test utilities, harnesses, mocks, and the small pieces of app/service code that make features testable.
 - Own the automation framework for your area keep it clean, fast, and low-maintenance rather than a source of flaky failures.
 Mobile Quality & Coverage - Own end-to-end quality for the features you cover, from reading the requirement to shaping the test strategy to signing off on the release.
 - Test across the mobile surface: API and backend contracts behind the app, performance and responsiveness on real devices, offline/edge conditions, and cross-device/OS compatibility.
 - Investigate failures to root cause, reproduce cleanly, and file reports crisp enough to need zero follow-up questions.
 Quality in the Pipeline 
 - Integrate automated checks into the build and release pipeline so quality gates run automatically on every commit and deploy.
 - Contribute to shift-left practices catching issues during the build, not after it.
 - Explore AI-assisted testing to generate, maintain, and prioritize tests, and to auto-add coverage based on the nature of changes.

 Required Qualifications - 2 to 5 years building test automation for mobile apps, or strong development skills with a genuine pull toward quality engineering.

We trust our people to manage their results and their time. Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren t just an employee; you are a partner in our success. Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission. Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for. Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively.  As a Staff Engineer - Network Security & Attack Path Intelligence, you will define and lead the technical direction of Safe s network reachability and attack-path intelligence capabilities across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will be the hands-on architect behind systems that connect network topology, identities, vulnerabilities, security controls, and business-critical assets to determine how attackers can move through an enterprise environment. You ll collaborate with product, backend, graph, data, AI, and platform teams to build scalable, explainable, and enterprise-ready attack-path capabilities. This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role. Core Responsibilities: Architect Safe s Attack Path Intelligence: Define the architecture and data model for network topology, effective reachability, trust boundaries, identities, vulnerabilities, controls, and attack paths across complex enterprise environments. Incorporate exploitability, control effectiveness, asset criticality, and business impact into prioritization.  About the Role We are looking for a Senior SQL Server DBA to take ownership of a large, complex on-premise SQL Server estate for an enterprise client. This is a hands-on, production-facing role weighted toward server migration and platform support, alongside day-to-day operational ownership not a monitoring-only position. The estate comprises multiple clustered SQL Server instances, including a production environment distributed across three servers with a separate disaster recovery setup and a one-to-one development clone. You will be the person accountable for keeping this estate healthy, resolving the issues it produces, and moving it safely.

 Daily Server Health Check & Maintenance Perform structured daily health checks across all instances: service and Agent status, database state, failed and long-running jobs, backup success, free space across data, log, tempdb and backup volumes, blocking sessions and error log review Monitor job duration against normal bands and investigate anomalies before they become failures Verify downstream data currency for priority reporting assets, including detection of jobs that succeed while loading stale or partial data Own scheduled maintenance: threshold-driven index and statistics maintenance within agreed windows, integrity checks, msdb and SSISDB history cleanup, and log file management Produce and circulate a daily health summary, and progressively automate routine checks into a single consolidated report Track capacity and growth trends — file growth, drive consumption and batch window drift — and forecast constraints ahead of impact 
 Access Management & User Support Manage the access request queue end to end across the database engine, SSAS cubes and SSRS — grant, modify and revoke within agreed SLAs Administer permissions through Active Directory groups rather than individual logins, maintaining an accurate access register Resolve access-related incidents: login failures, orphaned users after restores, permission escalation requests, service account and credential expiry, and job owner validation errors Maintain a central service account register covering owner, expiry date and dependent objects, with proactive expiry alerting Conduct periodic permission audits, remove leavers and privilege creep, and respond to audit and compliance queries on who has access to what Act as first point of contact for user-reported database and reporting access issues, with clear communication and turnaround 
 Database Administration Own backup and recovery: strategy design, verification, corruption handling and periodic timed restore drills against agreed RTO and RPO Manage instance configuration, index and statistics strategy, integrity checks and capacity planning Diagnose and resolve production incidents — blocking chains, transaction log exhaustion, tempdb contention, storage latency and query regression Establish monitoring baselines and alerting where none currently exist 
 Platform Services — SSIS, SSAS, SSRS Administer and support Integration, Analysis and Reporting Services: deployment, configuration, security, cube processing and subscription management Manage the SQL Server Agent job estate — ownership standards, proxy accounts, scheduling, dependency chains and failure triage 
 High Availability & Disaster Recovery Maintain and test clustering and DR configurations, including scheduled failover testing Own the DR runbook and document explicitly what falls outside high-availability coverage Change & Infrastructure Coordination Represent the database platform during Windows patching and infrastructure change windows — pre-checks, controlled service sequencing, post-change validation and pipeline catch-up Work with infrastructure, OS, storage and Active Directory teams, and escalate to vendor support with a supporting evidence pack Stakeholder Engagement Communicate incident status and business impact in plain language, on a predictable cadence Author root cause analyses and maintain runbooks, access registers and platform documentation 
 Required Skills & Experience Essential 6+ years administering production SQL Server, with demonstrable ownership rather than shared support Proven end-to-end server migration experience on a multi-database estate, with specific examples Strong backup and recovery capability — restore sequencing, corruption diagnosis, DBCC CHECKDB , RESTORE VERIFYONLY , and experience of real recovery scenarios Established daily operational discipline — able to describe their own health check routine and what they automated Practical experience resolving access issues across all three security models: engine logins and database roles, SSAS role-based cube security, and SSRS item-level permissions Understanding of orphaned users, SID mismatches and service account lifecycle management Hands-on SSIS administration: deployment models, SSISDB, protection levels, parameterisation and job troubleshooting Working knowledge of SSAS (including cube security and processing) and SSRS (including encryption keys and subscriptions) Performance diagnosis using wait statistics and DMVs — able to distinguish platform-bound from code-bound problems Clustering and/or Always On experience, including having performed a real failover Experience coordinating with infrastructure teams through patching and change windows Clear written and verbal communication in a client-facing setting Desirable Multi-source ETL integration experience across cloud storage, relational and SaaS sources SAP-sourced data warehouse exposure PostgreSQL or other non-SQL Server platform familiarity Partitioning strategy and large-table retention management Monitoring tooling and baseline instrumentation Experience implementing group managed service accounts (gMSAs) or automated credential rotation Microsoft certification — Azure Database Administrator Associate or equivalent

description:

 Site Coordination: - Visit project sites regularly and monitor actual progress. - Coordinate with Site Engineers, Project Managers, contractors, consultants, and clients. - Resolve execution issues through effective planning and communication. - Ensure timely availability of approved drawings, materials, machinery, and workforce. - Provide planning and execution guidance to Site Engineers and project teams.

 Coordination: - Coordinate with Procurement for timely availability of materials. - Coordinate with Design, Planning, Accounts, and Project teams. - Participate in project review meetings with management, clients, consultants, and government authorities. - Escalate critical project issues to management along with practical recommendations and recovery measures.

title: Senior Design Manager
description:
Job Title Senior Design Manager - Corporate Workplace Projects Department Workplace Design Team Job Overview Our client is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Design Manager to oversee the design and delivery of large-scale corporate workplace projects. As a Design Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring that our workplace environments are innovative, functional, and aligned with clients business goals. You will lead cross-functional teams, collaborate with external partners, and manage all aspects of design from concept to implementation to create exceptional, future-forward workplaces that meet the needs of our employees and stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Lead the design management of large corporate workplace projects, ensuring adherence to design standards, budget, and timelines. Act as the primary point of contact at the project level for client regarding design-related matters. Collaborate with internal cross functional teams including real estate, workplace strategy, workplace experience, property management, construction management, sustainability & operational technology, corporate security, brand and technology to develop design concepts that support business needs. Manage relationships with external design firms, architects, consultants, and contractors, ensuring effective communication and delivery of high-quality projects. Oversee design phases including schematic design, design development, and construction documentation, ensuring alignment with corporate standards and sustainability initiatives. Provide leadership in space planning, interior design, and furniture selection, ensuring the workplace environment fosters productivity, employee well-being, and innovation while aligning with clients Design Standards. Oversee the Client's Design Review Process, ensuring design reviews are performed by architects in alignment with client's Design Review Process, compliance with corporate guidelines, accessibility standards, and building codes. Stakeholders are identified and provide review / approvals in alignment with client's Design Review Process. Coordinate with project managers, vendors, and construction teams during the construction phase to ensure design intent is maintained. Stay current with industry trends and best practices in workplace design, applying innovative solutions to meet evolving needs. Provide post-occupancy evaluations and feedback loops for continuous improvement of workplace environments. Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field; Master s degree preferred. 15+ years of experience in managing corporate workplace design projects, preferably for large organizations or financial institutions. Strong knowledge of workplace trends, space planning, sustainability practices, and building systems. Excellent project management skills with a proven track record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget. Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and work collaboratively across departments and with external partners. Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, and Adobe Creative Suite. Knowledge of local building codes, ADA requirements, and other regulatory standards. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience working within a large corporate environment, particularly in the financial sector. Familiarity with WELL Building Standards, LEED certification, or other sustainability frameworks. Experience in managing design projects that involve complex technology integration and hybrid workplace strategies. Work Environment This is a hybrid role with some travel required to other corporate locations as necessary. The ideal candidate is flexible, adaptable, and capable of managing a diverse range of workplace projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for a creative and technically strong Architect Designer to join our Design team. The role will involve designing and developing residential and high-rise projects, translating project requirements into functional, aesthetically strong and commercially viable architectural solutions. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Develop concept designs, schematic designs and detailed architectural designs for residential and high-rise projects. Prepare and review plans, elevations, sections, layouts and architectural drawings. Coordinate with structural, MEP, landscape, interiors and other consultants to ensure design integration. Ensure designs comply with applicable building codes, development regulations and project requirements. Support the design development process from concept to execution, ensuring alignment with approved design intent. Review architectural drawings, design details and consultant submissions for accuracy and constructability. Work closely with project, engineering and execution teams to resolve design-related issues. Participate in design reviews, presentations and stakeholder discussions. Incorporate market trends, functionality, customer requirements and project positioning into design solutions. Ensure timely delivery of design drawings and documentation as per project milestones. Identify opportunities to improve design efficiency, cost optimisation and project quality. 

 Required Skills & Competencies 

 Strong knowledge of residential architecture and high-rise design. Good understanding of planning, space utilisation, building regulations and construction processes. Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit and/or other architectural design software. Strong design development and architectural detailing skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with consultants and cross-functional teams. Good communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills. Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects/milestones. Understanding of design feasibility, constructability and cost considerations. 

 Preferred Profile 
 Bachelors degree in Architecture (B.Arch.) from a recognised institution. 4-8 years of relevant experience in architectural design, preferably with a real-estate developer/architectural consultancy. Experience in residential developments, high-rise towers and large-scale housing projects will be preferred. Candidates with experience handling projects from concept/design development through execution will be an advantage.
