title: Sr Virtual Designer
description:
Job Summary 
 vConstruct is seeking an experienced Senior Modeler with strong structural steel detailing expertise and advanced knowledge of Tekla Structures and AISC standards. This role is responsible for independently delivering complex modelling and detailing work while providing technical guidance and support to other modelling resources. The role combines hands-on technical delivery, design interpretation, constructability, coordination, quality ownership, and team mentoring. The Senior Modeller works closely with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, BIM/VDC teams, and other stakeholders to develop accurate, coordinated, and fabrication-ready models and drawings in accordance with project requirements, client requirements, fabrication standards, and applicable codes. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support project initiation, project setup, preparation of estimates, model readiness, and project kickoff. Review client detailing manuals, project standards, details and specifications to help establish necessary documentation for effective 3D modelling and detailing. Thoroughly Interpret structural drawings, specifications, addendum, reference models, RFI s and other design information to understand and apply design intent. Support project delivery planning by coordinating modelling tasks, internal schedules, planned hours, and milestone requirements. Model primary and secondary structural steel for critical items, complex connections, miscellaneous items such as embeds, stairs, handrails, ladders etc. Review design documents for missing information, discrepancies, conflicts, and potential constructability issues and raise RFI s for technical queries. Coordinate with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, BIM/VDC teams, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues timely. Provide day-to-day technical guidance to Junior Modelers and Modelers. Support project teams in monitoring modelling progress, productivity, and delivery readiness and proactively communicate technical risks, schedule risks, challenges, and potential impacts to project leadership timely. Incorporate approved design revisions, RFIs, and client comments into models and deliverables in a controlled manner and track the COR s. Support the review and release of final deliverables in accordance with established project quality processes and client requirements. Collaborate with checkers to identify opportunities to improve modelling quality, productivity, consistency, and delivery efficiency. Maintain a strong focus on first-pass quality and minimizing downstream rework. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to support coordinated project delivery. Support effective information management, maintain consistency in model standards, numbering, templates, reports, and project-specific workflows. Contribute to the development and improvement of modelling standards, procedures, checklists, templates, and workflows. Support the development and use of Tekla custom components, auto connections, templates, reports, and other productivity tools. Share knowledge, best practices, workflows, and lessons learned with the broader team. Support technical training, skill development, and onboarding of new team members as required. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Independent ownership of complex technical assignments from interpretation through delivery. High-quality deliverables with strong first-pass quality and minimal downstream rework. Effective resolution of complex modelling, coordination, and constructability challenges. Accurate, coordinated, constructible, and fabrication-ready structural steel models and drawings. Strong collaboration with Project Leads, Project Managers, Checkers, Engineers, and other project stakeholders. Effective technical guidance and mentoring of Junior and intermediate modelling resources. Consistent application and improvement of project standards, workflows, and detailing practices. Proactive communication of technical risks, challenges, and delivery impacts. Improved modelling productivity, quality, consistency, and digital delivery capabilities. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Diploma or bachelors degree in civil engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered. 8+ years of experience in structural steel detailing, with significant experience in 3D steel modelling. Strong hands-on experience with Tekla Structures, preferably on U.S.-based structural steel projects. Strong knowledge of structural steel detailing, fabrication, and erection practices. Good working knowledge of AISC standards and U.S. structural steel detailing practices. Experience working with engineers, fabricators, Project Managers, Checkers, and multidisciplinary project teams. Demonstrated ability to provide technical guidance or mentoring to Junior and intermediate modelling resources. 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Advanced proficiency in Tekla Structures. Strong structural steel 3D modelling and detailing skills. Complex steel connections and constructability. Miscellaneous steel modelling and detailing. Strong understanding of AISC, OSHA and relevant U.S. detailing practices. Working knowledge of Tekla Power-Fab and Trimble connect. Proficiency in Bluebeam or similar review/markup tools. Understanding of BIM/VDC coordination and multidisciplinary workflows. 
 
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience with U.S. structural steel projects. Experience with Tekla automation, custom components, templates, reports, and workflow optimization. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to technical quality. Knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, or other BIM/VDC platforms. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop other team members. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and delivery commitments. A continuous improvement mindset with an interest in innovation, standardization, and knowledge sharing.

title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description:
Job Summary At Arctic Wolf, you won t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - youll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. If you re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you! Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We re looking for a Product Manager-Platform to be part of making this/that happen. Position Overview and Objective This Technical Product Manager role drives requirements, execution, and delivery for reliable, scalable data lake infrastructure and intelligent AI/ML capabilities that power Arctic Wolf s security products and platform operations. The TPM translates complex business, security, and operational needs into clear product requirements and technical specifications-initially supporting 1-2 engineering squads (scaling to 2+) across sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and milestone tracking. The role collaborates closely with Data Engineers, Data Science Engineers, Platform Architects and cross-functional stakeholders to support use cases such as log availability, telemetry analysis, threat detection, and intelligent alerting while ensuring solutions adhere to robust data security, privacy, and governance standards. The role requires foundational technical fluency in distributed data systems and AI/ML lifecycles, Agile execution, and the ability to represent data platform capabilities authoritatively to integrating teams. Responsibilities Works with senior PMs to understand how data platform infrastructure and AI-enabled capabilities align with the broader platform vision and roadmap. Gathers and authors requirements, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data pipelines, query services, data lake access layers, and AI/ML model integration workflows. Defines project-level success criteria. Owns the product backlog and delivery execution for 1-2 engineering squads (growing to 2+), managing prioritization, dependencies, risk mitigation, and on-time release milestones. Collaborates with stakeholders (Platform Engineering, Data Science teams, Security Operations, and Architecture) to assess system capabilities, onstraints, and architectural trade-offs. Validates, where possible, that High-Level Designs (HLDs) cover all validated use cases, data processing workflows, and performance requirements for platform features. Presents direction, roadmaps, and delivery status for data platform and intelligent capabilities to development teams and consuming product stakeholders. Answers authoritatively questions from teams integrating against data platform APIs, pipelines, and data access layers: what is supported today, what needs to be specified, and what is out of scope. Identifies high-demand, heavy-lift platform requests, cost-optimization opportunities, and emerging AI use cases for consideration in future strategy and planning sessions. Knowledge & Experience Knowledge of Product Management discipline, requirements definition, and Agile/Scrum ceremonies and practices. Educational background in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or 2-5 years of equivalent technical/product experience. Foundational understanding of distributed data systems, data pipelines, relational/non-relational data modeling, REST APIs, and cloud infrastructure components (e.g., AWS, GCP). Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and lifecycle concepts (e.g., training datasets, model evaluation metrics, inference pipelines, anomaly detection, or NLP). Understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards. Begins to develop a system-level approach, understanding how data platform architecture, query performance, and indexing decisions ripple across consuming security products and operational costs. Exposure to security concepts such as logging pipelines, telemetry analysis, monitoring, or threat detection systems a plus. Complexity and Problem Solving Collaborates with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Data Science Engineers, and internal stakeholders to maintain backlog priority, sizing, and acceptance criteria for data platform and AI enablement work. Communicates and escalates unexpected delays, cross-team blockers, data quality issues, or non-prioritized asks from integrating teams. Analyzes platform telemetry, query latency/throughput, data reliability metrics, and performance signals to determine the highest-value backlog items and platform optimizations. Collaboration & Interaction Partners with Engineering to define technical acceptance criteria and ensure tickets/epics are properly documented before scheduling into sprints. Collaborates with consuming product teams and operational stakeholders to define success criteria and validate that data platform and AI features resolve the intended operational challenges. Engages Engineering to monitor telemetry related to platform usage, storage/compute efficiency, and AI effectiveness, reporting regularly on key operational metrics. Develops strong working relationships with Engineering and Data Science teams as a trusted technical subject-matter partner, and proactively collaborates with peer Product Managers as well as cross functional teams. Why This Role This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. Youll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. Youll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart. On-Camera Policy To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

title: Technical Product Manager (Japanese/English) - CS & Trust & Safety
description:
Introduction We are looking for a hands-on Technical Product Manager to own product strategy and measurable outcomes for the tools and workflows that power Customer Support (CS) and Trust & Safety (TnS) for Mercari. You will identify high-impact problems, create the roadmap, write clear product requirements, manage delivery, and measure results. This role requires strong product judgment, practical use of data and AI, and the ability to bridge Japan-based stakeholders and the India engineering team in Japanese and English. About Us Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission. Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management. For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company. About Mercari India Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercaris applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100+ members over about Four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect Indias cutting-edge technology and knowledge. Our Culture To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organisation and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives. Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values: Go Bold All for One Be a Pro Move Fast Our organisation is also shaped by our four foundations: Sustainability Diversity & Inclusion Trust & Openness Well-being for Performance Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organisation. We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviours and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognised, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari s culture. Work Responsibilities Own Product Strategy and Outcomes Define the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes for CS and TnS Identify opportunities using customer feedback, operational insights, and data Define success metrics, baselines, guardrails, and post-launch measurement plans Balance customer experience, operational efficiency, risk, and business priorities Lead Discovery and Delivery Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch plans Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear priorities for engineering Manage projects from discovery through development, rollout, adoption, and iteration Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions across teams Improve CS and TnS Products Build tools and workflows that improve support quality, resolution speed, and operational productivity Improve user reports, escalations, moderation, case management, and enforcement experiences Identify opportunities for workflow simplification and automation while preserving appropriate human judgment Partner with CS, TnS, engineering, data, ML, policy, and business teams to deliver measurable impact Use AI and Connect Japan and India Use AI to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, prototyping, and product workflows Lead discussions and create clear product documentation in Japanese and English Build shared context and align Japan-based stakeholders with the India engineering team Bold Challenges The role balances customer experience, operational efficiency, marketplace risk, and business priorities while improving the tools and workflows used by CS and TnS teams. Success requires identifying high-impact problems, aligning Japan-based stakeholders and the India engineering team, and turning ambiguous operational needs into measurable product outcomes. Minimum Requirements 3+ years of professional experience in product management or a related field, with hands-on experience delivering digital products Japanese proficiency equivalent to JLPT N3 or above, with strong conversational ability to lead discussions with Japan-based stakeholders. Practical communication skills are more important than certification alone. Experience owning product work from discovery and roadmap creation through launch and measurement Ability to define measurable outcomes and make decisions using qualitative and quantitative data Experience creating roadmaps and PRDs and managing cross-functional projects Working knowledge of SQL or comparable analytical tools Practical experience using AI tools in product work Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and operations teams Preferred Requirements Experience with marketplaces, e-commerce, seller platforms, or B2C products Exposure to customer support, internal tools, operational workflows, Trust & Safety, risk, or compliance Familiarity with experimentation, workflow automation, or AI-enabled products Experience working in distributed or multicultural teams Working Conditions Employment Status: Full-time Office: Bengaluru Hybrid workstyle We believe in high performance and professionalism. title: Manager -Support (Hosting Service Owner)
description:
Job Overview The On Premise & Azure Cloud Hosting Service Owner is accountable for the strategy, performance, and lifecycle management of the organisation’s hosting services across both traditional datacentre environments and Microsoft Azure. This role ensures that compute, storage, virtualisation, backup, and cloud hosting platforms are secure, resilient, cost optimised, and aligned with business needs. Acting as the authoritative owner of hosting services, the Service Owner defines the service roadmap, governs operational processes, and ensures that hosting platforms—whether on premise or cloud—deliver consistent, high quality outcomes. They work closely with infrastructure teams, cloud engineers, security, architecture, and external service providers to maintain service stability, manage capacity, and drive continuous improvement. The successful candidate combines deep technical understanding of hosting technologies with strong service management discipline. They provide leadership during major incidents, oversee change governance, manage vendor performance, and ensure that hosting services evolve in line with modern cloud and hybrid cloud strategies. Responsibilities & Duties* Own the full lifecycle of on-premise and Azure cloud hosting services, including compute, storage, virtualisation, backup, and platform services. Define and maintain the service strategy, roadmap, and service catalogue entries. Ensure hosting services meet performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency targets. Oversee datacentre hosting platforms (VMware/HyperV, physical servers, SAN/NAS storage, backup infrastructure). Ensure capacity, performance, and resilience are proactively managed. Govern patching, firmware updates, hardware lifecycle, and platform upgrades. Govern Azure landing zones, resource groups, compute, storage, networking, and PaaS services. Ensure cloud environments follow best practices for cost optimisation, tagging, RBAC, and security baselines. Oversee Azure policy compliance, monitoring, and automation pipelines. Ensure patching, firmware, and hypervisor updates are consistently applied. Proactively identify capacity risks, ageing hardware, and end of support technologies. Enforce Azure governance (naming standards, tagging, RBAC, policy compliance). Monitor and remediate security recommendations (Defender for Cloud, identity hygiene). Ensure unused, misconfigured, or noncompliant resources are removed or corrected. Maintain accurate CMDB and asset data for all hosting components. Ensure backup success rates, retention policies, and recovery tests meet standards. Drive automation to reduce manual effort and eliminate configuration drift. Act as the hosting service authority during major incidents affecting compute, storage, or cloud services. Ensure platform upgrades and migrations follow structured release processes. Track and report on hosting performance, capacity, cost, and incident trends. Use data to identify service gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement. description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Job Title: 
 Senior Full Stack Developer

 Job Description 
 A Senior Full Stack Developer is a key player in our software development process, responsible for designing, 
 implementing, and maintaining web and mobile applications across the full stack. We are seeking a highly skilled 
 Senior Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic and collaborative team. The ideal candidate has strong expertise 
 in front-end development with ReactJS, Next.js, TypeScript, and responsive CSS, along with hands-on 
 experience building cross-platform mobile apps in React Native (Expo). On the back end, they are proficient in 
 Node.js and TypeScript, and can design, develop, and deploy scalable, efficient services on AWS using both 
 containers (ECS Fargate) and serverless (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB), backed by PostgreSQL 
 for relational data. 
 Responsibilities 
 Full Stack Development 
 
 
 Lead end-to-end development of web and mobile applications, from concept to deployment. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver high-quality 
 solutions. 
 
 Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including planning, development, testing, and 
 deployment. 
 
 
 Troubleshoot and debug issues across the entire stack to ensure smooth functionality. 
 Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to suggest improvements and innovations.. 
 Front-end Development 
 
 
 Develop and maintain user interfaces using ReactJS, Next.js, and TypeScript. 
 Build and maintain cross-platform mobile screens with React Native (Expo), sharing types and logic with 
 the web app. 
 
 Implement responsive CSS (Tailwind / NativeWind) to ensure an optimal experience across devices and 
 screen sizes. 
 
 
 Apply modern state management (React Query / Context / Redux) in complex applications. 
 Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement design specifications and enhance user interactions. 
 Back-end Development 
 
 
 Design, implement, and maintain scalable, efficient server-side services in Node.js and TypeScript. 
 Design, develop, and deploy services on AWS using both containers (ECS Fargate) and serverless (AWS 
 Lambda, API Gateway). 
 
 
 
 
 
 Model relational schemas in PostgreSQL and design DynamoDB access patterns; own migrations and 
 data integrity. 
 Design idempotent, retry-safe RESTful APIs and type-safe shared contracts (e.g. zod) consumed across 
 web, mobile, and backend. 
 
 
 Integrate APIs with front-end and mobile clients to ensure seamless data flow. 
 Implement security best practices to protect data and user information. 
 Architecture Design 
 
 Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to design decisions across front-end, mobile, and 
 back-end systems. 
 
 
 
 Define and enforce coding standards, development patterns, and best practices. 
 Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and performance of the overall system architecture. 
 Contribute to infrastructure-as-code using AWS CDK (TypeScript). 
 Testing 
 
 
 
 Write and advocate for automated tests unit and integration as a standard part of the definition of 
 done, not an afterthought. 
 Ensure critical paths (data models, API endpoints, lifecycle/business rules) are covered by meaningful 
 tests. 
 Contribute to test tooling and keep the suite fast and reliable in CI. 
 Task Management 
 
 
 Translate business rules, desired functionality, and functional specs into well-scoped development tasks. 
 Estimate, design, and implement those tasks as clean, reviewable code. 
 Project Management 
 
 
 
 Work with product/project managers to estimate effort, plan releases, and deliver on time. 
 Break complex work into manageable, independently shippable tasks. 
 Coordinate with cross-functional teams to align technical work with product goals. 
 Quality Assurance 
 
 
 Define and enforce testing strategies that keep the application reliable and stable. 
 Champion automated testing processes and tooling across the team. 
 Communication 
 
 
 Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical team members. 
 Clearly articulate technical concepts, trade-offs, and decisions to both technical and non-technical 
 stakeholders. 
 
 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical 
 experience). 
 
 
 
 5+ years as a Full Stack Developer, including senior-level ownership. 
 Strong proficiency in ReactJS, Next.js, TypeScript, and responsive CSS for front-end development. 
 Hands-on experience with React Native / Expo for mobile (or strong, demonstrated willingness to ramp 
 quickly). 
 
 
 
 
 Expert in Node.js and TypeScript for back-end development. 
 Experience with modern state management (React Query / Context / Redux). 
 Proven experience building serverless applications on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3). 
 Solid PostgreSQL experience schema design, migrations alongside NoSQL/DynamoDB 
 access-pattern modeling.

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Position : Human Resource Executive Experience : 12 Years Reporting To : Founder / CEO or Designated Manager Employment Type : Full-time Salary: Up to 20K /Month 
 About the Role : 
 We are looking for an HR Executive who can take care of the regular HR work in the office and keep things properly organized. The person will mainly handle recruitment, employee joining, attendance, leave, documentation, employee coordination and other day-to-day HR activities. This role is suitable for someone who is comfortable talking to people, follows up on work regularly and does not wait for someone to remind them about every task. 
 What You Will Be Doing : 
 You will be responsible for handling recruitment activities, starting from finding candidates and checking CVs to arranging interviews, speaking with candidates, following up with them and coordinating their joining. You will keep track of open positions and make sure candidates are followed up properly. If there is a delay in hiring, you should be able to identify it and bring it to the manager's attention. You will also take care of the joining process for new employees, including collecting documents, KYC, induction, access, KRAs and initial training coordination. Attendance and leave records need to be maintained properly. Employee documents and other HR records should also be kept updated and confidential. You will coordinate with managers regarding employee KRAs and performance reviews and make sure the required information and follow-ups are completed on time. Employees may come to you with regular questions or concerns. You should be able to understand the issue, handle it where possible and involve management when the matter needs a decision. You will also help organize employee activities such as training, birthdays, small team events and other engagement activities. When an employee leaves the company, you will coordinate the exit process, including notice period follow-up, handover, company asset return, exit interview and documentation. A weekly HR update will also need to be prepared covering recruitment status, attendance, new joining's, employee issues, pending documentation and other important HR matters. If you notice repeated issues with attendance, employee behavior or any other HR matter, you should bring them to the management's attention instead of ignoring them. 
 What We Are Looking For : 
 Good communication skills (English) and the confidence to speak with employees and candidates. Someone who is comfortable making regular follow-up calls and messages. Good knowledge of basic HR and recruitment activities. Ability to conduct initial candidate discussions and understand whether a candidate is suitable for the position. Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with HRMS or other HR software will be an advantage. Good documentation and record-keeping habits. Ability to handle employee information with confidentiality. Someone who can remain calm while dealing with employee issues or difficult conversations. Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes responsibility for their work and gets things done without needing constant supervision. 
 The Right Person For This Role : 
 The right person will be friendly and approachable with employees but will also know when to be firm. You should be comfortable working independently, following up with people and keeping track of several things at the same time. We do not expect you to make management-level decisions. We do expect you to identify problems, keep the management informed and make sure routine HR work does not get stuck. 
 Please Note : 
 Final decisions related to hiring, salary, increments, promotions, termination and major disciplinary matters will be taken by the Founder, CEO or the authorized manager.

title: Immediate Hiring - Implementation Engineer
description:
We are looking for Industrial Deployment Engineers MES & IT/OT Integration who are interested in building a career in smart manufacturing, MES, Industry 4.0 and industrial digitalization. 
 You will work with manufacturing customers to understand their shop-floor processes and configure, integrate, test and deploy iTraceX for real-world manufacturing use cases. 
 This is a hands-on engineering and customer-site role , not a conventional software desk job. You will work across the complete industrial technology flow: Manufacturing Process Machine PLC/HMI Industrial Connectivity iTraceX/MES ERP & Enterprise Systems 
 Freshers are welcome. Selected candidates will receive training and project exposure across MES, manufacturing processes, industrial automation and IT/OT integration. 
 Roles & Responsibilities Understand customer manufacturing processes, production flow, stations and operational requirements. Understand production orders, routing, BOM/materials, WIP, quality, rework, rejection and traceability requirements. Translate manufacturing use cases into iTraceX/MES configurations and workflows . Configure and deploy iTraceX for customer-specific manufacturing requirements. Participate in onsite installation, integration, testing, commissioning and production go-live. Understand PLC/HMI signals, tags/registers, machine states, events and equipment handshakes required for MES integration. Work with customer automation teams, PLC programmers and machine/equipment suppliers. Work with industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP and related interfaces . Understand and troubleshoot IT/OT connectivity across machines, PLC/HMI, gateways, networks, servers and applications. Work with SQL/databases, REST APIs, JSON and system interfaces . Support integration with ERP, PLC/HMI, barcode scanners, industrial printers, RFID, vision systems and other shop-floor equipment. Perform functional, integration, negative, boundary, recovery and exception testing. Participate in FAT, SAT, UAT, commissioning, go-live and stabilization . Troubleshoot issues systematically across machine, PLC/HMI, connectivity, middleware, MES and enterprise systems. Perform root-cause analysis and coordinate issue resolution with customers, internal teams and external vendors. Work closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, IT and Automation teams. Prepare configuration documents, interface details, test cases, deployment records and RCA reports. Train customer operators, engineers and system users. Provide onsite and remote support during implementation and post-go-live stabilization. Follow configuration management, change management, version control and deployment practices. Take ownership of assigned activities through successful completion. 
 Candidate Profile We are looking for candidates who: Have strong logical and analytical thinking. Enjoy hands-on technical troubleshooting and problem solving. Are curious about how machines and manufacturing processes work. Have an interest in both IT/software and OT/industrial automation . Can approach problems systematically rather than through trial and error. Have basic computer and networking knowledge. Are willing to learn manufacturing, MES, PLC/HMI and integration technologies. Can communicate clearly with customers and technical teams. Are comfortable working in manufacturing/shop-floor environments. Are willing to travel extensively to customer locations. Are willing to support commissioning and go-live based on customer production schedules. Can work effectively with operators, engineers, IT teams, automation teams and equipment suppliers. Demonstrate ownership, discipline and professional behaviour at customer sites. Technical Skills Preferred / Good to Have Exposure to any of the following is an advantage: MES | PLC | HMI | SCADA | OPC UA | Modbus | Kepware | SQL | REST API | JSON | TCP/IP | Windows | Linux | Industrial Networking | Barcode/RFID | Industrial Printers | ERP | IIoT | Industry 4.0 | Traceability | Manufacturing Systems These skills are preferred but are not mandatory for freshers. Experience 0–3 Years Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Candidates with 1–3 years of experience in MES, PLC/HMI, SCADA, industrial automation, manufacturing IT, IIoT, system integration, industrial networking or application deployment will have an advantage. Prior MES experience is not mandatory. Travel Requirement: Candidates must be willing to travel and work at customer manufacturing facilities across India. Depending on business and project requirements, selected employees may also get opportunities for international customer deployments . Customer-site assignments may require staying at project locations for multiple days or weeks or months during implementation, commissioning go-live & hypercare. Career Growth- ThoughtMakes intends to develop selected candidates into engineers capable of working across the complete industrial execution environment. Typical career progression: Trainee Industrial Deployment Engineer Industrial Deployment Engineer Senior Industrial Deployment Engineer MES & Industrial Integration Specialist Technical/Solution Lead Solution Architect / Delivery Lead High-performing employees may get opportunities to participate in international projects and regional operations . Why Join This Role? This role provides an opportunity to build expertise across: Manufacturing + MES + Industrial Automation + OT + IT + System Integration Rather than specialising only in software or PLC programming, you will learn how manufacturing processes, machines, automation systems, industrial networks, MES and enterprise applications work together. Our objective is to develop engineers capable of going to a manufacturing facility, understanding the production requirement, interacting with production and automation teams, analysing IT/OT connectivity, configuring the MES solution, troubleshooting integration issues and taking the system successfully into production. 
 Interested candidates can share your resume to sowmiya.n@thoughtmakes.com; For further enquiry contact: N. Sowmiya HR Manager 7397748008

title: Information Security Manager
description:
About the Role We are looking for a hands-on and execution-oriented Information Security Manager to take end-to-end ownership of the organization's ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System (ISMS) while strengthening the organization's technical security, customer security assurance, Secure SDLC, and AI security practices. This is not a purely compliance or documentation-focused role. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that information security controls are continuously implemented, monitored, measured, evidenced, and improved throughout the year. The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating across GRC and technical security, independently driving security initiatives, managing audits and remediation, responding to customer security requirements, and translating security requirements into practical controls. Key Responsibilities 1. ISMS & ISO 27001 Operations 40% Own and continuously operate the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS. Manage policies, procedures, registers, risk assessments, SoA, and compliance obligations. Drive risk identification, treatment, monitoring, escalation, and closure. Define and track ISMS objectives, KPIs, corrective actions, and continuous improvement. Coordinate Management Reviews, internal audits, surveillance/recertification audits, and audit readiness. Drive security awareness, training, onboarding awareness, and phishing simulations. 2. Hands-on Technical Security 25% Manage VAPT, vulnerability scanning, remediation, and retesting. Review security configurations across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, AWS/Azure, and access controls. Drive least privilege, patch compliance, and periodic access reviews. Coordinate security incident triage, containment, RCA, corrective actions, and escalation. Support CERT-In reporting, security monitoring, threat intelligence, and control improvements. 3. Customer Security Assurance & Third-Party Risk 20% Own customer security questionnaires, assessments, due diligence, and audits. Conduct vendor and third-party security risk assessments. Review security requirements in NDAs, contracts, DPAs, and outsourcing arrangements. Support Sales/AM teams in customer security discussions and pre-sales engagements. Maintain security evidence, certification information, and a reusable security questionnaire/evidence library. 4. Secure SDLC & AI Security – 15% Drive Secure SDLC, secure coding, and application security practices. Support SAST, SCA, secret scanning, vulnerability management, and CI/CD security controls. Partner with engineering teams on security findings, project risks, architecture, and access reviews. Assess AI/LLM security risks, including prompt injection, data disclosure, excessive privileges, insecure outputs, and unauthorized access. Promote recognized AI and application security best practices Mandatory Qualifications & Experience 5–8+ years of relevant experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, GRC, ISMS, or a closely related domain. Strong hands-on experience in ISO/IEC 27001:2022 implementation and ISMS operations. Practical experience managing information security risk registers, risk assessments and treatment plans, Statement of Applicability (SoA), internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions, and audit readiness. Strong practical understanding of information security controls and their implementation within an organization. Experience in VAPT, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, and security findings management. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID security. Good understanding of cloud security across AWS and/or Azure. Experience coordinating information security incidents and response activities. Experience in responding to customer security questionnaires, assessments, and security due diligence requests. Good understanding of vendor and third-party security risk assessments. Understanding of Secure SDLC and application security practices. Exposure to SAST, SCA, secret scanning, CI/CD security controls, or similar application security practices. Awareness of emerging AI/LLM security risks. Strong documentation, analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills. Good to Have CISSP / CISM / ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or equivalent certification. Experience working in an IT services, software development, product engineering, or technology consulting organization. Experience supporting enterprise customers during security audits and due-diligence exercises. Knowledge of CERT-In and Indian information security compliance requirements. Knowledge of security frameworks such as CIS Controls, NIST CSF, OWASP, and OWASP ASVS / Top 10. Exposure to cloud security posture management and identity/security tools. Experience with AI Security, GenAI Security, or LLM application security assessments. Experience with enterprise security platforms, vulnerability management tools, SIEM, or security monitoring solutions. What We Are Looking For Hands-on and execution-oriented, rather than purely documentation-focused. Comfortable working across both GRC and technical security. Capable of independently driving security actions with IT, Engineering, Cloud, and Business teams. Confident interacting directly with enterprise customers and external auditors. Comfortable managing audits, evidence, remediation, risks, and deadlines throughout the year. Able to translate security and compliance requirements into practical and measurable controls. Strong in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration. Analytical, structured, detail-oriented, and capable of identifying security gaps proactively. Curious about emerging security risks, particularly cloud, applications, and AI security. Comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions. Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of an established ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS and play a key role in strengthening the organization’s overall information security maturity. The role provides exposure across ISMS, GRC, technical security, cloud security, application security, customer assurance, third-party risk, Secure SDLC, and emerging AI security, making it an ideal opportunity for a security professional looking to build a broad and impactful information security profile. If you enjoy turning security requirements into real-world controls, driving continuous improvement, and working closely with both technology and business teams, this role offers significant ownership and visibility.

 Role Overview We are looking for an HR professional with strong hands-on experience in Employee Relations, Labour Laws and HR Legal matters . The role will be responsible for managing employee-related cases, disciplinary matters, separation-related disputes and labour/legal matters in coordination with the HR and Legal teams. The ideal candidate should have practical experience in handling cases such as absconding, notice-period violations, employee misconduct, termination disputes, recovery matters and labour complaints/cases . Key Responsibilities Employee Relations & Case Management Handle employee relations cases from initiation to closure. Manage cases related to absconding, absenteeism, misconduct, policy violations and disciplinary issues . Investigate employee complaints and disputes and recommend appropriate action. Coordinate with HRBPs, business teams and managers on sensitive employee matters. Maintain proper documentation and case records. Draft/review show-cause notices, warning letters, charge sheets, termination letters and other legal/HR communications . Provide guidance to HR teams on appropriate and legally compliant actions. Handle employee representations, grievances and disputes arising from disciplinary actions. Support domestic enquiry proceedings, wherever applicable. Litigation & Legal Notice Management Coordinate responses to legal notices received from employees/ex-employees . Prepare case summaries, employee history, supporting documents and factual briefs for external lawyers. Track ongoing employee/labour cases and ensure timely follow-up. Maintain a tracker of legal notices, disputes, cases and their status. Labour Law Compliance Keep abreast of applicable labour and employment laws. Support HR in identifying and mitigating legal risks in employee-related processes. Review HR processes and documentation from a labour-law perspective. Candidate Profile Must-have experience: 4–8 years of experience in HR Employee Relations / HR Legal / Labour Relations / Industrial Relations . Hands-on experience handling employee disputes and disciplinary cases . Experience dealing with absconding, notice-period recovery, termination and separation-related cases . Exposure to Labour Courts / Labour Commissioner / labour authorities and coordination with external lawyers. Good understanding of Indian Labour & Employment Laws. Strong drafting, documentation and communication skills. Preferred: LLB / LLM qualification. Experience in a large employee-base organisation, preferably Retail, F&B, Hospitality, FMCG, Manufacturing or other multi-location businesses . Key Competencies Employee Relations Labour Law Disciplinary Proceedings Legal Notice Management Labour Litigation Coordination Investigation & Case Handling Legal Drafting Stakeholder Management Strong documentation and follow-through Practical understanding of HR risk Success Measures Timely closure of employee cases and disputes. Effective handling of disciplinary and separation-related matters. Reduction of avoidable legal/labour disputes. Timely response to legal notices and labour authority matters. Strong documentation and compliance in employee actions.

description:

Job Title: HR-People & Organization Manager Company: Sage Healthy Global Location: Avadi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India(Work from office) Position Type: Full-time; based in the Avadi office 
 Build a workplace where strong people join, grow, and stay. 
 Sage Healthy provides medical billing and revenue cycle management services to healthcare practices across the United States. Our Avadi team works with colleagues in North America to improve billing accuracy, reimbursement, and service delivery. Our people and technology underpin the quality and continuity of that work. 
 Position Summary: 
 The People & Organization Manager leads the full HR function for Sage Healthy Global, with accountability for recruitment, retention, rewards, recognition, employee relations, policies, and reliable HR administration. This is a hands-on management role that turns business needs into practical people initiatives and measurable improvements in hiring, employee experience, and team stability. 
 The manager partners with India operations, department leaders, Business Operations & Finance, and corporate leadership to build capable teams and support fair, consistent management. The role owns HR service quality and coaches or supervises assigned HR support staff, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and approval controls. 
 Responsibilities: 
 1. Recruitment and Onboarding Agree staffing priorities, job profiles, selection criteria, and hiring timelines with department managers within approved headcount and budgets. Build candidate pipelines through local networks, referrals, institutions, and relevant recruitment channels; lead structured screening, interviews, and offer coordination. Own joining readiness and onboarding, including documentation, induction, manager handoffs, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day check-ins; track early performance and retention. 
 2. Retention and Employee Engagement Identify preventable turnover through employee feedback, stay conversations, departure feedback, and analysis by team and tenure; agree corrective actions with managers. Run a practical engagement calendar and short employee surveys; communicate findings and follow through on agreed improvements. Support career conversations, internal mobility, and a positive employee experience for office-based and remote India staff. 
 3. Rewards and Recognition Review market information and internal pay consistency; recommend salary ranges, increments, benefits, and incentives with Finance and leadership approval. Administer approved compensation review and reward processes with documented criteria, budget checks, and clear employee communication. Build timely, fair recognition for individual and team contributions, service milestones, and company values; monitor participation across teams and work locations. 
 4. Performance and Development Coordinate goal setting, probation reviews, performance discussions, and development plans with clear deadlines and completion tracking. Coach managers on feedback, performance concerns, documentation, and fair treatment; support appropriate improvement plans and escalation. Identify training needs with department heads, coordinate delivery, and assess whether learning improves job performance and readiness for greater responsibility. 
 5. Employee Relations and Policies Provide an accessible, confidential channel for employee concerns; handle matters promptly, document outcomes, and escalate sensitive cases to designated leadership or advisers. Maintain clear people policies and support consistent application across hiring, attendance, leave, conduct, performance, and separation. Coordinate applicable employment compliance, workplace dignity and harassment-prevention processes, required training, and records with qualified local advisers. Promote respectful conduct and embed Sages values: One Team, Excellence, See It Through, Courage, and Growth. 
 6. HR Administration and Payroll Coordination Own accurate employee records, employment documentation, attendance and leave data, benefits administration, and timely updates in the HR system. Validate and submit payroll inputs, including joiners, leavers, attendance, and approved salary changes; resolve discrepancies with Business Operations & Finance. Coordinate employee benefit and statutory administration with Finance and advisers, maintaining clear owners and calendars for required actions. Manage separations, handovers, employee communications, and final-settlement inputs; coordinate access removal and asset return with Infrastructure & Support. 
 7. People Planning and Process Improvement Maintain a practical people plan aligned with staffing demand, organizational changes, and management priorities; flag capacity and succession risks early. Standardize HR workflows and service expectations, delegate routine tasks where resources permit, and improve HR system use and data quality. Coordinate confidentiality and security training with relevant teams; restrict employee information to authorized users and maintain appropriate records. 
 8. Reporting and Accountability Provide a concise monthly dashboard covering time to fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, voluntary turnover, engagement feedback, and recognition participation. Track timely onboarding, probation and performance reviews, payroll-input accuracy, and closure of employee concerns and agreed actions. Establish baselines and agree realistic targets with leadership within the first 60 days; review results monthly and own corrective actions with department managers. Operate within delegated authority. Obtain approval for headcount, compensation changes, incentive budgets, policy changes, and significant employment decisions. 
 Requirements: Ability to combine hands-on HR delivery with ownership of recruitment, retention, and employee engagement outcomes. Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and follow-through when handling sensitive employee and management matters. Ability to coach managers, resolve problems constructively, and collaborate across functions and locations. Clear written and spoken English and effective Tamil communication for the local workforce. Availability to work from Avadi and coordinate with international colleagues as required. 
 Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in human resources, business administration, psychology, or a related discipline; a postgraduate HR qualification is preferred. Experience: Typically 58 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years leading HR initiatives or a team, with evidence of improved hiring, retention, or engagement. Functional knowledge: Practical experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, compensation reviews, and HR administration. Local knowledge: Working knowledge of employment requirements and HR practices relevant to Tamil Nadu, with the judgment to seek specialist advice. Systems and analytics: Proficiency in an HR platform such as Keka, Microsoft Excel, and concise management reporting; ability to turn data into action. Industry exposure: Experience in medical billing, healthcare services, BPO, IT-enabled services, or a comparable service organization is preferred. 
 Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and role scope, paid monthly on the last working day. Annual vacation and personal time off follow company policy and applicable requirements. Bonus eligibility after the first year is subject to the approved scheme and employment terms. The role offers opportunities for professional growth. 
 Note: This profile outlines the principal responsibilities of the People & Organization Manager and may evolve with business needs. Management will confirm reporting arrangements, delegated authority, and individual performance targets.

Key Skills: Human Resource Management,HR Operations,Employee Retention,HR Generalist Activities,HR Coordination,Performance Management System,Corporate HR,Employee Engagement

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION ADMIN & HR EXECUTIVE Company: Crown Rubber Polymers 
 Location: Gurgaon Sector 47 & Sector 15
 Department: HR & Administration
 Working Hours: 10:00 AM – 7:30 PM (9 hours working + 30-minute break)
 Weekly Off: Sunday

 Holiday: As per company policy
 Reporting To: Management 
 Role Overview : We are looking for a proactive, disciplined and responsible Admin & HR Executive to manage day-to-day HR and administrative activities, employee attendance, factory monitoring, documentation, compliance, reporting and coordination. The candidate will act as a link between Management, Factory HR & Admin, Accounts, Security and other departments , ensuring that instructions are followed, tasks are completed on time and accurate information is reported to management. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. HR Operations Manage employee records, joining and exit formalities. Maintain daily attendance, leave, absenteeism and overtime records. Prepare salary and advance data and coordinate with Accounts. Assist with ESIC and other applicable statutory compliance. Handle employee-related documentation and queries. Maintain HR registers, checklists and records. 2. Factory Monitoring & Security Monitor CCTV and employee movement regularly. Conduct random headcounts and attendance verification. Monitor security guards, visitors and material movement. Track inward/outward material movement and reconcile with records. Identify and immediately report suspicious activities, unauthorized movement, employee idle time or other irregularities. Monitor factory activities after working hours through authorized CCTV/mobile systems. 3. Administration Manage office and factory administrative activities. Maintain physical and digital company records. Coordinate with vendors, banks, government offices and other external parties. Support tender documentation and official correspondence. Draft professional letters, emails and other communications. Coordinate with HR, Accounts, Marketing and other departments. 4. MIS, Reporting & Follow-up Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports and dashboards. Provide accurate real-time updates to management. Maintain daily HR/Admin checklists and task trackers. Track pending tasks and ensure timely completion. Immediately escalate important issues and deviations to management. 5. SOP & Process Management Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists and systems for HR and Administration. Ensure employees follow company procedures and policies. Identify process gaps and suggest improvements. 6. Coordination & Accountability Follow up on management instructions until completion. Coordinate between Head Office, Factory, Accounts, HR, Security and other departments. Maintain discipline and confidentiality. Take ownership of assigned responsibilities without repeated reminders. Visit factory/office as required for HR audits, salary distribution, training and compliance checks. Perform additional HR/Admin responsibilities as assigned by management. Key KPIs Performance will primarily be measured on: Accuracy & timely submission of reports Attendance and employee-record accuracy Timely identification and reporting of irregularities Completion of assigned tasks within deadlines Follow-up and closure of pending tasks CCTV, security and factory monitoring HR/Admin documentation and compliance Discipline, reliability and ownership Real-time communication with management 
 Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree is mandatory. 2–3 years of relevant experience in HR, Administration, Factory Operations or a similar role. Manufacturing/factory experience preferred. Minimum 70% academic performance throughout preferred. 
 Required Skills Strong knowledge of HR & Administration. Good knowledge of attendance, payroll basics and ESIC. Excellent Excel/MS Office skills. Good English communication and drafting skills. Strong documentation and reporting ability. Good CCTV/monitoring and coordination skills. Strong follow-up and problem-solving ability. High integrity, confidentiality and professionalism. Self-driven, proactive and comfortable working independently.

 As a Senior HR Executive, you will act as the backbone of our employee lifecycle, managing everything from seamless onboarding to graceful exits. You will ensure our payroll runs without a hitch, our workplace culture remains vibrant, and our organization remains 100% compliant with Indian labor laws and IT industry standards. If you are a process-driven HR professional who knows how to leverage technology to automate and streamline HR functions, we want you on our team.
 Who You Are Personality & Interpersonal: You have a chirpy and bubbly personality that naturally connects with people. Highly emotionally intelligent, you can easily read the mood of the workforce and are deeply passionate about fostering a positive work environment. Drive & Ownership: You are driven, ambitious, and actively looking to transform into an HR Manager role. You take full ownership of the HR function, working closely with leadership to proactively identify improvement areas and close those gaps. Functional Expertise: You possess strong operational HR skills, are deeply knowledgeable about payroll and statutory compliance, and are skilled in compensation planning. Crucially, you have a strong willingness to grow from operational tasks into strategic HR leadership. Systems & Efficiency Mindset: You are comfortable leveraging AI to drive efficiency and productivity. You focus heavily on building resilient systems and processes that teams can learn from, effectively reducing the organization's dependency on any single individual. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Keka HRMS Mastery & Data Insights Act as the absolute Subject Matter Expert (SME) and primary administrator for our Keka HRMS platform. Flawlessly configure, update, and manage all Keka modules, including Leave & Attendance, Payroll, Performance Management, and Expense flows. Create and automate backend workflows and customized reports. Prepare weekly and monthly HR reports that surface workforce-related challenges in alignment with business priorities. Troubleshoot system glitches, adapt the platform to evolving company policies, and train staff on using the portal effectively. 
 2. End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management Onboarding: Handle pre-joining and onboarding formalities. Generate offer letters, conduct thorough background verifications (BGV), set up IT assets, and execute engaging induction programs. Offboarding/Exits: Manage seamless exit formalities, conduct empathetic exit interviews, manage departmental clearances, and ensure accurate Full & Final (FnF) settlements. 
 3. Payroll, Compensation & Budgeting Manage end-to-end pre-payroll activities, ensuring 100% accuracy in leave, attendance, and loss of pay (LOP) data within Keka. Oversee salary structuring, tax declarations, and take charge of compensation planning. Propose and manage the overall HR budget, working closely with the founders to allocate sufficient budget for high-impact employee welfare and engagement activities. Coordinate with the Finance/Accounts team to process monthly payroll on time, resolving grievances promptly. 
 4. Performance Management & Team Leadership Oversee and manage a 360 performance appraisal system that drives high performance and continuous growth across the company. Mentor junior HR team members , conducting regular 1:1s and empowering the team to achieve more. Promote a results-driven culture while actively maintaining high team morale. 
 5. Employee Experience & Relations Interact with remote and in-office employees, maintaining a healthy balance and cohesive culture between the remote and in-person experience. Design and execute high-impact employee engagement initiatives, team-building activities, and workplace wellness programs tailored to IT professionals. Act as the first point of contact for employee grievances, resolving conflicts professionally, empathetically, and in strict adherence to company policies. 
 6. Statutory Compliance & IT Industry Standards Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of Indian labor laws applicable to the IT sector (e.g., Shops and Establishments Act, Maternity Benefit Act, POSH). Ensure strict compliance and timely remittance of all statutory deductions (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, and Gratuity). Stay updated on changing labor regulations and minimum wage revisions to advise management on risk mitigation. 
 7. Core HR Administration Draft, update, and enforce HR policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs), ensuring these processes are well-documented for the team. Maintain highly confidential employee records, organizational charts, and digital files securely. 
 Qualifications & Requirements Experience: 6 to 7 years of proven experience in HR Operations, preferably within the IT/Software Services industry. Keka Proficiency (Mandatory): Must have advanced, hands-on administrative experience with Keka HRMS. You should know how to configure policies from scratch and troubleshoot backend settings. Compliance Knowledge: Deep, practical understanding of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, PT), and payroll processing. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of drafting professional internal communications, policies, and managing vendor relations. Problem-Solving: High emotional intelligence, discretion with confidential information, and a proactive approach to conflict resolution. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 What Sets You Apart Previous experience independently implementing or migrating an organization to Keka HRMS. Strong data analysis skills using Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, Pivot tables) in conjunction with Keka data exports.

Key Skills: KEKA HRMS,HRIS,Statutory Compliance,MIS Reporting,HR Policies,Payroll,Employee Engagement,Performance Management

The role requires strong recruitment expertise, excellent communication, and the ability to manage multiple requirements within defined TATs/SLAs . 
 Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment for lateral and entry-level positions. Understand hiring requirements and coordinate with Hiring/Production Managers on candidate profiles and expectations. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, employee referrals, job portals, walk-ins, and other recruitment channels . Screen resumes and conduct preliminary/telephonic interviews to assess candidate suitability. Evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, communication, compensation, notice period, location, and role fit . Coordinate and schedule Manager/Hiring Manager interview rounds and ensure timely feedback. Track open requisitions/RIDs and maintain recruitment pipelines to achieve defined TAT/SLA and hiring targets . Coordinate salary discussions and negotiations with the HR/Business Manager. Manage offer rollout, offer acceptance, and pre-joining engagement to minimize offer dropouts and no-shows. Issue and coordinate Offer Letters, Appointment Letters, and Contract Agreements as applicable. Manage joining formalities, documentation, background verification, pre-boarding, and onboarding coordination . Collect required candidate documents and ensure accurate and timely updates in Oracle/HRMS and recruitment trackers . Coordinate the handover of new hires to the Training/Induction team . Maintain recruitment MIS, dashboards, funnel reports, trackers, and hiring status updates . Monitor recruitment deadlines and ensure timely follow-up with candidates and stakeholders. Participate in walk-in drives, virtual hiring drives, campus hiring, referral campaigns, and other recruitment initiatives . Ensure adherence to HR policies, ISMS requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes . Support Internal Job Posting (IJP) and other HR initiatives when required. Identify opportunities to improve sourcing effectiveness, recruitment TAT, candidate conversion, quality of hire, and offer-to-join ratio . Take up additional responsibilities based on business requirements . 
 Key Skills Strong hands-on experience in End-to-End Recruitment / Talent Acquisition . Expertise in Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, job portals, and candidate sourcing techniques . Strong candidate screening and interviewing skills. Good salary negotiation and offer management skills. Strong stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and follow-up skills. Ability to manage multiple open positions and high-volume recruitment . Good understanding of TAT/SLA, recruitment funnel, conversion ratios, and offer-to-join metrics . Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS/ATS, Oracle, MIS, and recruitment trackers . Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and process compliance . Ability to work effectively in a target-driven and fast-paced environment . Qualification & Experience Graduate/Postgraduate in HR, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline . 3 - 6 years of relevant experience in Recruitment / Talent Acquisition. Experience in IT, BPM, BPO, Digital Services, or Corporate Recruitment is preferred. Experience handling both lateral and volume hiring will be an advantage. Candidates with experience in stakeholder management or team/people coordination are preferred. Key Performance Areas Hiring target achievement Recruitment TAT / SLA adherence Quality of hire Candidate pipeline management Source effectiveness Interview-to-selection conversion Offer-to-join ratio MIS and recruitment data accuracy Candidate experience Stakeholder satisfaction

description:
Position Title: Executive - HR Reports To: Senior Manager - HR Location: Bangalore About Company We are a digital systems company and a community of passionate, purpose-led individuals seeking to enhance peoples lives with technology. We deliver solutions with speed and at scale to address our customers complex business challenges. We are one of the largest providers of Digital Applications and Technology Solutions on SAP Cloud Platform (SCP) and SAP on-premise platform. To learn more about Incture, visit incture.com Culture at Incture We take pride in trust, transparency and open communication across all levels. You will thrive, if you are open to learning and making a difference in an intrapreneurial and fast-paced environment. We offer competitive salary and perks and a meritocracy driven career growth path. Job Description & Responsibilities We are looking for a results-driven Recruitment Executive to support our IT hiring and staffing business. The role will be responsible for sourcing, screening, engaging and closing technology talent across multiple skill sets, while working closely with hiring managers, business teams and staffing stakeholders. The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to IT recruitment/staffing, lateral hiring, candidate engagement and recruitment delivery , with the ability to manage multiple requirements and hiring priorities simultaneously.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 1. IT Recruitment & Staffing 
 Manage end-to-end recruitment for IT and technology positions across lateral and volume hiring requirements. Understand job requirements, technical skills, experience and business context to identify relevant talent. Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, internal databases, referrals, social platforms and other channels. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals across key technology skill areas. Handle multiple open positions and staffing requirements simultaneously while maintaining delivery timelines. 
 2. Candidate Management 
 Conduct initial screening and assess candidates against technical, experience and behavioural requirements. Drive candidate engagement throughout the recruitment process and ensure a positive candidate experience. Coordinate interviews, feedback, documentation, compensation discussions and offer closure. Maintain regular communication with candidates to improve conversion and reduce drop-offs. Build long-term talent pools for frequently hired technology skills. 
 3. Stakeholder & Hiring Manager Management 
 Work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, delivery teams and business stakeholders to understand current and future hiring needs. Provide regular updates on recruitment progress, pipeline quality, ageing positions and hiring challenges. Seek feedback on candidate quality and continuously refine sourcing and screening strategies. Escalate hiring risks and bottlenecks proactively. 
 4. Staffing / Deployment Support 
 Support staffing requirements by identifying candidates aligned to specific project, client or deployment needs. Work with staffing teams to understand project requirements, availability and deployment timelines. Maintain visibility of candidate status from sourcing through selection, offer and joining. Support quick turnaround hiring for critical project requirements. 
 5. Recruitment Operations & MIS 
 Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment data in the ATS/recruitment trackers. Track key recruitment metrics such as CV submissions, interview ratios, selection ratios, offer-to-join ratios, TAT and ageing positions . Prepare regular recruitment dashboards and hiring reports. Ensure adherence to recruitment processes, documentation and compliance requirements. 
 Success Measures 
The role will be measured on:
 Hiring Delivery | Time-to-Fill | Pipeline Quality | CV-to-Interview Conversion | Interview-to-Selection Conversion | Offer-to-Join Ratio | Candidate Experience | Stakeholder SatisfactionSkills: Strong understanding of IT recruitment and technology staffing Hands-on experience with lateral hiring and volume hiring Good understanding of common IT skills such as Java, .NET, SAP, Cloud, Data, DevOps, Testing, ERP, etc. Strong sourcing and candidate identification skills Good understanding of LinkedIn, job portals and digital sourcing channels Strong candidate engagement and negotiation skills Ability to work on multiple requirements under tight timelines Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Data-driven and target-oriented approach High ownership, responsiveness and follow-through Qualification: Post Graduate Experience Desired: 3-8 Yrs in IT recruitment / IT staffing / RPO / recruitment consulting

 Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Manager IT Recruitment to head and build the IT Recruitment Practice at Wroots Global. This is a leadership role for someone who can take complete ownership of the IT Recruitment function from building and managing the recruitment team to driving client delivery, developing recruitment strategies, improving processes, and contributing to the growth of the IT Recruitment business. The person will be responsible for creating a strong and scalable IT recruitment practice at Wroots and will work closely with the leadership team to define and execute the overall recruitment strategy. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Own the IT Recruitment Practice Take complete ownership of the IT Recruitment Practice at Wroots. Develop and execute the overall strategy for growing the IT recruitment business. Build a scalable recruitment function capable of handling multiple clients and high-volume as well as niche hiring. Define recruitment processes, standards, SLAs, and performance benchmarks. Continuously improve the way Wroots delivers IT recruitment services. Establish best practices across sourcing, screening, client management, interview coordination, offer management, and joining conversion. Build a strong reputation for Wroots as a preferred IT recruitment partner. 2. Build & Lead the Recruitment Team Build, manage, and scale the IT recruitment team based on business requirements. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and mentoring. Identify skill gaps and implement training and development programs. Ensure all client requirements are delivered within agreed SLAs and timelines. Develop recruitment strategies based on client requirements, technology, location, seniority, and talent availability. Ensure consistent quality of profiles and hiring outcomes. Monitor the complete recruitment funnel from requirement to joining. Personally support critical, niche, and senior-level mandates when required. Ensure Wroots consistently delivers against client expectations and maintains strong vendor performance. 4. Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and hiring stakeholders. Participate in client meetings, business reviews, requirement discussions, and escalations. Understand client hiring plans and proactively prepare the team for upcoming requirements. Work with clients to improve hiring processes, turnaround time, and quality. Identify opportunities to increase hiring volumes and expand relationships with existing clients. Position Wroots as a strategic recruitment partner rather than only a CV supplier. 5. Business Growth Work closely with the Wroots leadership team to grow the IT Recruitment business. Identify opportunities within existing accounts for additional hiring mandates. Support new client acquisition by providing recruitment capability, market insights, and delivery plans. Participate in client pitches, recruitment proposals, and solution discussions. Help develop and position Wroots' IT Recruitment and RPO capabilities. Contribute to revenue and profitability targets for the IT Recruitment Practice. Build long-term and scalable client relationships. 6. Drive the team's performance against the 54321 recruitment benchmark: 5 Profiles 4 Shortlists 3 Interviews 2 Offers 1 Joiner Ensure the team consistently delivers quality and maintains Wroots' position as a Top 3 vendor across active clients. 7. Process & Technology Build standardized recruitment processes across the IT Recruitment Practice. Identify and implement new sourcing methods, recruitment tools, and technologies. Drive effective use of LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Boolean/X-ray search, GitHub, AI-based sourcing tools, ATS/CRM, and other recruitment platforms. Introduce dashboards and reporting mechanisms to improve visibility and decision-making. Explore automation and AI opportunities to improve recruitment productivity. 8. Market & Talent Intelligence Develop strong understanding of the IT talent market. Track hiring trends, technology demand, salary trends, talent availability, and competitor activity. Build talent pools for high-demand and niche technology skills. Provide market insights to clients and the Wroots leadership team. Develop proactive sourcing strategies for emerging technologies and difficult-to-hire skills. Ideal Candidate We are looking for a recruitment leader who has the entrepreneurial mindset to build a practice, not just manage a recruitment team. 
 The ideal candidate should have: 8+ years of overall recruitment experience, preferably with strong IT recruitment exposure. 3+ years of experience managing recruitment teams or functions. Experience managing multiple enterprise clients and large recruitment mandates. Strong experience in technical, lateral, niche, and leadership hiring. Proven experience in building or scaling recruitment teams. Strong client-facing and stakeholder management experience. Experience in Recruitment Consulting, RPO, Staffing, IT Services, GCC, Product, or Consulting environments. Strong understanding of recruitment business metrics and commercial aspects. Demonstrated ability to achieve business and hiring targets.
